paragraphs: 今天是星期六。我和朋友去看足球。我们坐出租车去。
人很多。大家都很高兴。我喜欢红色的球队。他们的号码很好看。
比赛很好看。我们的球队赢了！朋友说：“下个星期我们再来吧。”我说：“好！”
translations: Today is Saturday. My friend and I are going to watch football. We take a taxi there.
There are lots of people. Everyone is very happy. I like the team in red. Their numbers look great.
The match is great. Our team won! My friend says, "Let's come again next week." I say, "OK!"

paragraphs: 我哥哥很喜欢踢足球。他每个星期三和星期六都去踢球。他的球队很小，只有十二个人。
今天下午，哥哥有一个比赛。妈妈、爸爸和我都去看。天气很好，不冷也不热。我们坐在前面。
比赛开始了。对面的球队很高，也很快。第一个球是他们的。妈妈说：“没关系，还有时间。”
下半场，哥哥踢得很好。他跑得很快，踢进了一个球！我们都站起来叫：“哥哥，好！”
最后是一比一。哥哥有点儿累，可是很高兴。晚上，我们一起去饭馆吃饭。哥哥吃了很多米饭。
爸爸问我：“你也想踢足球吗？”我想了想，说：“我想！明天我跟哥哥去学。”
translations: My older brother loves playing football. He plays every Wednesday and Saturday. His team is small, only twelve people.
This afternoon my brother has a match. Mum, Dad and I all go to watch. The weather is nice, not cold and not hot. We sit at the front.
The match starts. The other team is tall, and fast too. The first goal is theirs. Mum says, "It doesn't matter, there's still time."
In the second half my brother plays really well. He runs fast and scores a goal! We all stand up and shout, "Go, brother!"
In the end it's one-all. My brother is a bit tired, but happy. In the evening we go to a restaurant together. My brother eats lots of rice.
Dad asks me, "Do you want to play football too?" I think about it and say, "I do! Tomorrow I'll go and learn with my brother."

paragraphs: 我喜欢买旧衣服。今天我在网上看到一件黑色的衣服。
这件衣服很大，也很好看。它是日本的，有二十多年了。
我问卖家：“多少钱？”卖家说：“三百块。”我说：“太贵了！两百块，可以吗？”卖家说：“好吧。”我很高兴！
translations: I like buying old clothes. Today I saw a black jacket online.
This jacket is very big, and very nice-looking. It's Japanese, over twenty years old.
I ask the seller, "How much?" The seller says, "Three hundred kuai." I say, "Too expensive! Two hundred, is that OK?" The seller says, "Fine." I'm so happy!

paragraphs: 小林是我的朋友。她有一个小店，在学校后面。店里的衣服都是旧的，可是都很好看。
星期天上午，我去她的店。店里人不多。小林在喝茶，她说：“你来了！坐吧。”
我看到一件白色的衣服。它很长，很大。小林说：“这件是九十年代的，是日本人做的。”
我问：“多少钱？”小林说：“五百块。”我说：“有点儿贵。”她笑了：“你是我朋友，四百吧。”
我穿上这件衣服。镜子里的我很不一样！小林说：“太好看了，你买吧。”
我买了这件衣服。回家的时候，我很高兴。妈妈看到了，问：“这是新衣服吗？”我说：“不是，是旧的，可是我很喜欢。”
translations: Xiao Lin is my friend. She has a small shop behind the school. The clothes in the shop are all old, but they all look great.
On Sunday morning I go to her shop. There aren't many people. Xiao Lin is drinking tea. She says, "You're here! Sit down."
I see a white piece of clothing. It's very long and very big. Xiao Lin says, "This one is from the nineties, made by a Japanese designer."
I ask, "How much?" Xiao Lin says, "Five hundred kuai." I say, "A bit expensive." She laughs: "You're my friend, four hundred then."
I put it on. The me in the mirror looks so different! Xiao Lin says, "It looks great, buy it."
I buy it. On the way home I'm very happy. Mum sees it and asks, "Are these new clothes?" I say, "No, they're old, but I love them."

paragraphs: 我很喜欢看日本动画。每天晚上，我都看一个小时。
今天的动画很好看。一个小猫想找它的家。它走了很多天，很累。
最后，它找到了家。它的妈妈在门口等它。我哭了。妹妹说：“哥哥，你怎么哭了？”
translations: I really like watching Japanese anime. Every evening I watch for an hour.
Today's anime is really good. A little cat wants to find its home. It walks for many days and is very tired.
In the end it finds its home. Its mother is waiting for it at the door. I cried. My little sister says, "Brother, why are you crying?"

title_en: I want to go to Japan
paragraphs: 我是学生，今年十九岁。我很喜欢日本动画。我的房间里有很多动画的书。
我最喜欢的动画是一个男孩子的故事。他没有家，也没有钱。可是他有很多朋友。
他和朋友们一起去很远的地方。路上有很多事，有的很好，有的不好。他们都不怕。
我的朋友大卫也喜欢这个动画。我们每个星期五一起看。我们吃饭，喝茶，看动画，说话。
大卫问我：“你想去日本吗？”我说：“想！我想去东京，看看动画里的地方。”
现在我每天学习一点儿日语。明年，我想和大卫一起去日本。我们要坐飞机去！
translations: I'm a student, nineteen this year. I love Japanese anime. There are lots of anime books in my room.
My favourite anime is a boy's story. He has no home and no money. But he has lots of friends.
He and his friends go somewhere very far away. Lots happens on the way, some good, some bad. They aren't afraid.
My friend David likes this anime too. We watch it together every Friday. We eat, drink tea, watch anime and chat.
David asks me, "Do you want to go to Japan?" I say, "Yes! I want to go to Tokyo and see the places in the anime."
Now I study a little Japanese every day. Next year I want to go to Japan with David. We'll fly there!

paragraphs: 明天我去北京。我坐飞机去，飞机上午十点走。
北京很大，人也很多。我想去看看学校和商店。我也想吃北京的菜。
我的中国朋友在北京工作。他说：“我去飞机场找你。”我很高兴，明天见！
translations: Tomorrow I'm going to Beijing. I'm flying there; the plane leaves at ten in the morning.
Beijing is very big and has lots of people. I want to look around the schools and shops. I also want to eat Beijing food.
My Chinese friend works in Beijing. He says, "I'll come and find you at the airport." I'm so happy. See you tomorrow!

paragraphs: 我昨天到了上海。上海很大，也很漂亮。天气有点儿热，我穿了一件白色的衣服。
上午，我去了一个饭馆。服务员问我：“你想吃什么？”我说：“我要一个面条和一杯茶。”面条很好吃，也不贵。
吃了饭，我想去商店。我不认识路，就问一个老人：“请问，商店在哪儿？”老人说：“前面，走五分钟。”
商店里有很多东西。我买了一个杯子和一些水果。卖东西的人很好，她说：“你的汉语很好！”我笑了。
下午，我坐出租车回饭店。司机问我：“你是哪国人？”我说：“我是英国人。”他说：“欢迎你来上海！”
晚上，我给妈妈打电话。我说：“上海很好，我很喜欢这里。”明天，我想去看看上海的水。
translations: I arrived in Shanghai yesterday. Shanghai is very big and very beautiful. The weather is a bit hot, so I wore a white top.
In the morning I went to a restaurant. The waiter asked me, "What would you like to eat?" I said, "I'd like noodles and a cup of tea." The noodles were delicious and not expensive.
After eating I wanted to go to the shops. I didn't know the way, so I asked an old man, "Excuse me, where is the shop?" He said, "Up ahead, five minutes' walk."
The shop had lots of things. I bought a cup and some fruit. The woman selling things was very nice. She said, "Your Chinese is very good!" I smiled.
In the afternoon I took a taxi back to the hotel. The driver asked me, "Where are you from?" I said, "I'm British." He said, "Welcome to Shanghai!"
In the evening I called my mum. I said, "Shanghai is great, I really like it here." Tomorrow I want to go and see Shanghai's river.

paragraphs: 我每天七点起床。我先喝一杯水，再吃一点儿米饭。
八点，我坐公交车去学校。车上人很多，我没有座位。
九点上课。老师说：“同学们好！”我们说：“老师好！”今天我们学习汉字。我很喜欢写汉字。
translations: I get up at seven every day. First I drink a glass of water, then eat a little rice.
At eight I take the bus to school. There are lots of people on the bus, and I don't get a seat.
Class starts at nine. The teacher says, "Hello, everyone!" We say, "Hello, teacher!" Today we're studying characters. I love writing Chinese characters.

paragraphs: 今天是星期天，外面下雨了。我不想出去，就在家里。
上午，我在床上看书。书里的故事很有意思。我看了两个小时，有点儿累了。
中午，我想做饭。家里有米饭、鸡蛋和一些菜。我做了一个鸡蛋米饭。不太好看，可是很好吃！
下午，我的朋友小王给我打电话。她问：“你在做什么？”我说：“我在家里，外面下雨。”她说：“我来你家吧，我们一起看电影。”
三点，小王来了。她买了很多水果。我们坐在一起看了一个中国电影。电影很好看，我们都笑了。
晚上，雨不下了。小王回家了。我想：下雨的星期天也很好。
translations: Today is Sunday, and it's raining outside. I don't want to go out, so I stay at home.
In the morning I read in bed. The story in the book is very interesting. I read for two hours and got a bit tired.
At noon I want to cook. At home there's rice, eggs and some vegetables. I make egg fried rice. It doesn't look great, but it's delicious!
In the afternoon my friend Xiao Wang calls me. She asks, "What are you doing?" I say, "I'm at home, it's raining outside." She says, "I'll come to yours, let's watch a film together."
At three Xiao Wang arrives. She's bought lots of fruit. We sit together and watch a Chinese film. The film is great and we both laugh.
In the evening the rain stops. Xiao Wang goes home. I think: a rainy Sunday is nice too.

paragraphs: 我是大学生。我每个月有两千块钱。
吃饭要八百块，打车要两百块。我也喜欢买衣服和书。
这个月我买了太多东西。只有一百块了！我想：下个月，我要少买一点儿，多学习怎么用钱。
translations: I'm a university student. I have two thousand kuai a month.
Food costs eight hundred, taxis cost two hundred. I also like buying clothes and books.
This month I bought too many things. I only have a hundred left! I think: next month I'll buy a bit less and learn more about how to use money.

paragraphs: 我爸爸有一个小商店。商店在我们家前面，卖水果、茶和一些小东西。
每天早上六点，爸爸就去商店。他很忙，可是他很喜欢这个工作。
星期六我不上课，我去商店看爸爸。爸爸说：“你来得好！今天人很多，你帮我吧。”
一个女人想买苹果。她问：“苹果多少钱一斤？”我说：“八块一斤。”她买了三斤。我说：“二十四块。”她给了我三十块，我给她六块。
下午，爸爸问我：“今天我们卖了多少钱？”我看了看，说：“一千二百块！”爸爸很高兴。
晚上，爸爸说：“做生意不容易。你大学要好好学习，以后你来做我的老板吧！”我们都笑了。
translations: My dad has a small shop. It's in front of our house and sells fruit, tea and a few small things.
Every morning at six Dad goes to the shop. He's very busy, but he really likes this job.
On Saturday I don't have class, so I go to the shop to see Dad. Dad says, "Good timing! Lots of people today, give me a hand."
A woman wants to buy apples. She asks, "How much are the apples per jin?" I say, "Eight kuai a jin." She buys three jin. I say, "Twenty-four kuai." She gives me thirty and I give her six.
In the afternoon Dad asks, "How much did we sell today?" I check and say, "One thousand two hundred kuai!" Dad is very happy.
In the evening Dad says, "Doing business isn't easy. Study hard at university, and later you can be my boss!" We both laugh.
